description: Client-side fishing alerts, HUD, visuals, and timing for Agonia SMP.

mods.name: Agonia Fishing QoL
mods.description: Strictly client-side, notification-only fishing quality-of-life tool for Agonia.

releases.notes:
Client-side fishing feedback and visual improvements for Agonia SMP.

Features:
- Red, yellow, and green fishing-state visuals
- Personal Incoming and Bite alerts
- Estimated bite timing with Lure and weather adjustments
- Cast timer and fishing-rod durability HUD
- Custom local bobber, thicker line, and smooth approach trail
- Clear-water visuals and fishing-particle cleanup
- 21 built-in Bite sound presets with volume control
- Runtime master on/off switch
- Strict own-bobber isolation
- No autofishing or gameplay automation

Compatibility:
- Minecraft 26.2
- Fabric Loader 0.19.3+
- Fabric API 0.156.0+26.2
- Java 25

Installation:
Download agonia-fishing-qol-1.2.1.jar and place it in your Modrinth instance's mods folder.
